method: Individual source/v4/knee/full boards at 4x with 8x shoulder/hip/cuff details

frames.observation: Idle rest: shoulders, neckline, both wrist gaps and source ankle spans align.
Idle rise: collar and hem follow the one-pixel body rise; wrist scraps removed.
Idle variation: right wrist remains skin; source foot/ankle edges retained.
Idle lowered pose: outward hands stay clear of the hem and trouser edges.
Walk 1: raised screen-left leg and longer screen-right leg have independent contours and cuffs.
Walk 2: crossed stride retains body leg separation and both source ankle spans.
Walk 3: screen-left planted leg and bent screen-right leg remain distinct beneath the hem.
Walk 4: forward screen-left leg and shorter rear leg retain their individual cuffs.
Walk 5: right hand beside the thigh stays bare; knee and ankle follow their source rows.
Walk 6: close wrist/hip boundary remains clear; both bent leg contours align.
Walk 7: lifted screen-left foot and longer screen-right leg retain separate cuffs; forearm strip removed.
Walk 8: left hand beside hem stays clear; shortened left leg and leading right ankle follow the original pose.
